subject: ONE herring in a seller apron, silver blue, big round eye, fins as hands
second_characters: ONE crab buyer fighting him for the roe every beat, claw huge at the lens; ONE shrimp crossing the lens

props.big: ONE open glass jar packed with orange roe, carried in his fins
props.small: ONE tiny glass jar holding exactly ONE orange roe bead, ONE price card already flat on its side, 1499-99 on one line in six figures of one height, a hyphen between, nothing raised

environment: a stall walled in kelp and crates top and bottom, shoals and scales blowing through
lighting: bright daylight in clear turquoise water, cyan edge left, amber fill right
motion_rule: the frame is TALL and the hero fills at least half its height in EVERY beat, his head never under a quarter of it, always within a fin of the lens. The camera never stops: it orbits him on a hard arc, a new shot size every beat, medium to close, crates and kelp sweeping the full frame width behind him. He carries what he holds and throws his whole body the full frame width. ONE hero action per beat.

audio.pacing: first word at 0.0, every line said once, last word зубок done by 6.30, then glass and claws carry it
audio.lip_sync: mouth to the lens, opening on every syllable

timeline.a: bursts through a wall of crates filling the frame, hauling the open jar of roe full width; the crab rips at it, claw raking across the lens
swings that jar overhead, roe piling at the glass; the crab hauls his fin down, the shrimp whips across the lens
drives the open jar over the stall front, head filling the frame, crates sweeping behind; the crab cuts across the lens after him
the shrimp hurls him the tiny tagged jar across the lens, he catches it on the swing, ONE bead plain inside; the crab lunges after it
whips the tiny jar up over his eye, the camera carving round him; the crab hurls a crate across the lens
he pinches that ONE bead out between his fin tips and holds it at the lens, bead bigger than his eye; the crab snaps after it
he lays the ONE bead on a tooth and dives his open mouth at the lens, jaw shutting on it, the shrimp whipping under his chin
he hurls the emptied big jar out of frame and swings the tiny one full width, crates rushing; the crab grabs at the throw
he hauls the price card up face on beside his eye, the crab dragging his fin the other way
the crab hauls him round and he holds the card and the empty tiny jar out full frame, chewing

must_appear: the hero fills half the frame height start to end; at 4.00 exactly ONE bead in the tiny jar; at 6.30 that one bead held at the lens; at 8.70 his eye and the card share the frame, 1499-99 whole on one line, never cropped
negative_prompt: printed text, cyrillic words, spoken digits, superscript digits, a raised or smaller pair of figures, subtitles, watermark, speech bubble, a second tiny jar, more than one bead in the tiny jar, letterbox, a horizontal 16:9 picture, night, dark scene, studio lighting, a prop worked in place, a card stuck onto a jar in shot, a hero held in one pose, a hero running at the camera on his feet, parked camera, push in, motionless or empty background, wide shot, a small distant hero, a cut to another location, the hero's back to the camera, a motionless first or last second, a line said twice, speech after 6.30, offscreen narration, English speech, a second herring
